The main takeaway from our work is that

anti-TNF drugs bind to the surface-exposed transmembrane TNFa, and this binding triggers a series of events leading to uptake of the drug and processing of the drug into small peptides, some of which are presented by DC to T cells to initiate an anti-drug T cell response.
anti-TNF antibodies are internalized into cells by binding to TmTNFs expressed on the surface, which is a previously unrecognized mechanism of action for these drugs.
